purpose: Design reference for approval before further implementation
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one exceptionally polished, high-fidelity desktop app design reference for “Aphelion OS”, rendered edge to edge in a wide 16:10 frame, crisp legible UI, no browser chrome, device, desk, or presentation border.

This is a premium personal AI operating system: work with Claude and Codex, open ChatGPT, switch project folders, and use an Obsidian vault as shared memory. The main screen IS an immersive particle field. A magnificent, intricate blue-white coral sculpture made of hundreds of thousands of tiny luminous particles, flowing filament streamlines, organic perforated membranes, dark holes and sinuous tendrils fills most of the entire black screen. Show depth, fine grain and graceful three-dimensional structure, with icy blue inner regions and silver-white edges, scattered faint stars. It feels like a living vault of thoughts in an endless dark observatory. The particle scene continues behind all interface elements and reaches the edges.

Float a sparse, beautifully composed dashboard OVER this scene: low-opacity smoked glass, almost transparent with delicate silver hairline edges, subtle restrained frost and tiny reflections. Clearly see the particle field THROUGH the panels. Elegant ivory Cormorant Garamond style serif for titles; precise readable sans-serif for utility text. A discreet top frame reads “aphelion OS”, with “Overview”, “Knowledge”, “Sessions” and two compact dropdown controls “My vault” and “Select project”. A small floating glass agent palette reads “Intelligence”, “Claude”, “Codex”, “ChatGPT”, with restrained status dots. A quiet vault caption reads “Your living vault” and “Obsidian”. Near the bottom, a single broad translucent glass composer reads “Where shall we go from here?” with compact “Claude”, “Chat”, “Attach context” and a send arrow. Keep the sculpture spacious and dominant; controls peripheral, luxurious, usable, calm. No enclosing card around the particle scene, no opaque sidebar, no card grid, no giant marketing headline, no bright gradients, no purple neon, no charts, no invented metrics. Render a finished working app screen, not a poster.
approval: User supplied this image with the full implementation brief on 2026-10-28.
